_about: Kinds of question agents answer by hand with systemctl, journalctl, ss or ps: the state of a unit, which timers exist, what a unit's journal says. These are written against units every systemd Linux machine has (systemd-journald, systemd-logind, systemd-tmpfiles-clean.timer), so they run anywhere; the answers are checked against a live machine, not fixed forever. The kit has not been run against a model on them.

questions.q: Is the systemd-journald service running on this machine? Since when, and which scope (user or system) is it in?
What state is the systemd-logind service in on this machine, and is it enabled?
Is there a systemd timer on this machine that cleans temporary files? What is its name and when did it last run?
Which systemd units, user or system, are in the failed state on this machine right now?
